raj_customer: Hey, hitting 400 on /v1/tool-call. Response: \"malformed tool args\". Sample payload I sent below.

raj_customer: ```
POST /v1/tool-call HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Content-Type: application/json

{\"tool\":\"invoice_generator\",\"args\":{\"invoice_text\":\"Line1\r\nLine2\",\"amount\":120.00}}
```

sam_support: Can you confirm which SDK or HTTP client? also paste exact curl (including headers) and the raw bytes if possible.

raj_customer: We're using node-fetch v3.2. Repro with curl: 

raj_customer: ```
curl -i -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tool-call\" \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{\"tool\":\"invoice_generator\",\"args\":{\"invoice_text\":\"Line1\nLine2\",\"amount\":120.00}}'
```

raj_customer: Notice the payload contains a literal newline between Line1 and Line2 (copied from Windows editor) and we quoted with single quotes in bash. It fails even when we double-quote the outer string.

meera_engineer: Unescaped control chars (0x0A/0x0D) inside a JSON string are illegal per RFC 8259. Many parsers throw on literal CR/LF inside strings. Shells and copy/paste from editors can inject literal CRLF. Try sending invoice_text as \"Line1\\nLine2\" (escaped) or run JSON.stringify on the JS side before sending.

meera_engineer: Quick JS repro:

meera_engineer: ```js
const payload = {tool:'invoice_generator', args:{invoice_text:'Line1\\nLine2', amount:120}}
fetch(url, {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload), headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}})
```

sam_support: Short-term workaround: sanitize on client: .replace(/\\r|\\n/g, '\\\\n') or ensure you use JSON.stringify. We'll add a doc note. Also, API should return a clearer error message — current 400 just says 'malformed tool args' with no hint about control chars.

carol_eng_runtime: Thanks for the repro. Filing INF-3459 to improve the parser error -> return a specific validation error when we detect unescaped control characters. Can you share the request-id from your failing call so we can fetch server logs? We'll also evaluate a lenient acceptance mode behind a feature flag.

raj_customer: Request ID from failing call: req_01GABCDEFG12345. This is P1 for our customer, any ETA?

sam_support: Escalating to priority queue. @carol_eng_runtime can you flag for runtime on-call? :pray:

ci-bot: Collected logs for req_01GABCDEFG12345 and attached to INF-3459.

meera_engineer: For now we'll recommend client-side sanitize; patch ETA TBD once INF-3459 is triaged.

raj_customer: Thanks all, appreciate the quick triage.
